menus.name: Samrub Samrub Thai full-course menu
menus.note: Dinner only, two sittings (5.30pm and 8pm); prepaid in full when booking (THB 5,049.33 with service and VAT). Menu changes with the season

bookingOpens: Online on TableCheck, at the kitchen counter or at a table, for up to six guests; larger groups book through LINE (@samrubforthai) or by email (samrubforthai@gmail.com). The menu price is paid in full when booking.
cancellation: Free cancellation more than 14 days ahead; 50% of the prepayment is charged between 7 and 14 days ahead, and 100% within 7 days. The 10% administration fee is never refunded.
groups: Parties of more than six book through LINE (@samrubforthai) or by email.
duration: About two and a quarter hours: the 5.30pm sitting ends by 7.45pm. Guests more than 30 minutes late may miss some courses.
